reason: I already order through an agent company I trust and it has mostly worked out, so I have no reason to try a new name. And 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is too much when I can find something close in Shorja today and touch it first.
objection: Paying more than two thirds of the item price again just in fees, and handing money up front to a company nobody I know has used yet, then waiting three weeks for kids' things they might outgrow.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour ordered from them a few times without problems and the total fees came out clearly cheaper than my current service.
